Page disagreements recorded in the dossiers: Casale to Montferrat in 1292 (Casale page) against Matteo 'taking Casale' in 1292 (Matteo I Visconti page); Alessandria to the Visconti after 1313 (Visconti page) against 'protection' of Luchino Visconti in 1345 (Alessandria page); Asti returning to Galeazzo II 'seven years' after 1372 although he died in 1378, and Valentina's dowry in 1389 (Asti page); Cuneo conquered by Montferrat and acquired by Philip II of Taranto in 1356 (Lordship of Milan page).

State of Milan used six pages against a 2-5 budget because the review asked for the 18th-century losses; Valenza and Valsesia, named by the reviewer, are on no page opened, so the 1713 region follows the cell reading of house-of-savoy /ledger/24.
